units.source_text: 问题这样简单地解决了。

en.t: The matter was settled so simply.

units.source_text: 可是，我不想马上离开，我同名人夫人闲聊了一会儿。

en.t: However, I did not want to leave right away, so I chatted for a while with the Master's wife.

units.source_text: 名人后来不论是对延期还是对对手大竹七段，都没有谈及一句。

en.t: Afterward, the Master did not say a single word about either the postponement or his opponent, Otake 7-dan.

units.source_text: 延后一天算不了什么，但名人已经等得不耐烦了，

en.t: A delay of one day was not much, but the Master had already grown impatient from waiting,

units.source_text: 眼看着明天就要对局，这样情绪将会受到挫伤，

en.t: and with the match about to take place tomorrow, his spirits would be dampened by this,

units.source_text: 对竞技中的棋手来说，并不是不重要的问题。

en.t: which, for a go player in the midst of competition, was by no means an insignificant matter.

units.source_text: 这个问题连工作人员也不敢贸然跟名人谈。

en.t: Even the staff did not dare to bring up this matter rashly with the Master.

units.source_text: 我来求他是万不得已，这一点名人肯定敏锐地洞察到了。

en.t: The Master must have keenly perceived that I had come to ask him only because there was no other choice.

units.source_text: 他若无其事地应允，深深感动了我。

en.t: His casual consent, as if it were nothing at all, moved me deeply.
